questions.question: [Boolean Logic and Relational Databases] Normalise to 3NF: Student(StudentID, Name, CourseID, CourseName, TutorID, TutorName)
questions.correctAnswer: FDs: StudentID->Name, CourseID->CourseName, TutorID, TutorID->TutorName. 1NF: atomic. 2NF: remove partial FD (CourseID->CourseName). questions.question: [Programming Fundamentals] Write a function that reads a file of integers and returns the median
questions.correctAnswer: def median_from_file(filename): with open(filename) as f: nums = sorted(int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()) n = len(nums) if n == 0: return None mid = n // 2 return nums[mid] if n % 2 else (nums[mid-1] + nums[mid]) / 2
